title: Asset section shows Asset name and VIN / Serial when present
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists whose work order has an asset attached, and that asset has a VIN (and a separate asset has only a serial number).
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. On a document whose asset has a VIN, look at the asset section.
3. On a document whose asset has only a serial number (no VIN), look at the asset section.
expected:
1. The asset section shows the asset name, labeled exactly "Asset".
2. When the asset has a VIN, one value labeled exactly "VIN / Serial" shows the VIN.
3. When the asset has no VIN but has a serial number, the "VIN / Serial" value shows the serial number.
4. The VIN is preferred when both exist.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9143 (Story 4, Asset Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, section S4-R1, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Asset section shows whenever the work order has an asset (parts sales too)
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach: a service work order with an asset, a parts sale with an asset attached, and a work order with no asset attached.
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
5. For a parts sale, open it via "Customers" -> the customer -> "Part Sales" tab -> open the part sale -> "Finance" tab (or "Parts" -> "Part Sales").
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. For a service work order with an asset, check whether the asset section shows.
3. For a parts sale with an asset attached, check whether the asset section shows.
4. For a work order with no asset attached, check whether the asset section shows.
expected:
1. The asset section shows whenever the work order has an asset attached — including on part sales, treated the same as service work orders.
2. When the work order has no asset attached, the asset section is hidden entirely.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9143 (Story 4, Asset Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S4-N3 and the Story 4 prerequisite, read on 31 August 2026.
